question: Examine the statements related to Judo competitions:1) The contest area includes a minimum 8×8 metre fighting zone and a 3-metre safety zone.2) The competitor wearing blue is introduced before the competitor in white.Which statement(s) is/are correct?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Only statement 1**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Statement 1**: The contest area in Judo competitions includes a minimum **8×8 metre fighting zone** and a **3-metre safety zone**.

 
 
• The fighting zone is the area where the actual combat takes place, and the safety zone surrounds it to ensure the safety of players, preventing injuries during throws or falls.
 
• These dimensions are in accordance with **International Judo Federation (IJF) regulations**. This statement is ***correct***.
